messages:
jordan_revops: Morning — HelionX sent INV-4127, the reserved commit line looks fine but there's a duplicate 'burst' charge for the same window 2025-05-07T03:12Z with identical token counts. Can someone confirm if this is a billing duplicate?

maria_fin: Can you paste the invoice snippet and account id? I'll open a ticket if it looks off.

jordan_revops: Sure — snippet from the PDF below:
```
Invoice: INV-4127
Account: HLX-8892
Lines:
- reserved_commit | pool: hlx-prod | tokens: 1,200,000 | amount: $6,000
- burst_overage    | pool: hlx-prod | window: 2025-05-07T03:12Z | tokens: 45,000 | amount: $225
- burst_overage    | pool: hlx-prod | window: 2025-05-07T03:12Z | tokens: 45,000 | amount: $225
Total: $6,450
```

kevin_eng: We ran an automated failover at 03:12 UTC yesterday for the hlx-prod nodepool. My initial guess is the usage snapshot was emitted twice (primary + failover) and somehow both made it into the billing aggregator. I'll pull infra logs to confirm.

billing_bot: Invoice INV-4127 ingested into billing pipeline at 2025-05-08T09:04:12Z. Dispute flag: none.

maria_fin: Thanks. I'm creating ticket BLG-2025-811 and putting a provisional credit hold while we investigate. @kevin_eng can you attach the failover logs and any request-id tracebacks to the ticket?

kevin_eng: Adding logs now. From a quick look I see two usage snapshots within ~18s. The aggregator should de-dupe by snapshot_id but it looks like our failover produced a new snapshot_id before the primary's snapshot reconciled. Possible race condition.

jordan_revops: Customer wants a short timeline + explanation by EOD and asked about SLA credit if this ends up increasing their bill.

maria_fin: Understood. I'm requesting a provisional credit up to $300 while BLG-2025-811 is open. If reconciliation confirms duplicate billing, we'll issue a full reversal and kick off the SLA credit workflow. I'll also include the short write-up for HelionX. :white_check_mark:

kevin_eng: I'll add a remediation note to the ticket and propose a small fix to the snapshot de-dupe. ETA for patch: tomorrow morning.

jordan_revops: Great — please ping when BLG-2025-811 has the provisional credit applied so I can update the customer. :pray:

maria_fin: Done — provisional credit recorded on BLG-2025-811. Finance notified for review.

maria_fin: tagging this as billing ops + infra, will follow up in the ticket with final reconciliation.
